scope: Executable reuse of existing native action families; inventory of other established families without a mass redesign.
authority_order: Named existing native sibling and its implementation
This inventory records implementation and verification scope; it does not grant product approval
constraints: New controls reuse a named existing family or document an explicit, scoped deviation.
No global Button style override; each shared family applies only at its call sites.
Palette roles come from AuroraInstrument, including Light, Dark and Increase Contrast branches.
Save, Cancel, native text Undo/Redo and Return in multiline text retain their own semantics.
No addition Undo, addition status row, replacement toast, notification or timer is introduced.
SDK/build metadata and lexical source gates do not prove native visual or gesture equivalence.

behavior: Action, validation, saving state, accessibility ID and shortcut belong to each caller.
Each existing caller places its small saving ProgressView inside the primary label.

source: Both named button chains use auroraPrimaryAction.
Direct borderedProminent is defined only by AuroraPrimaryActionModifier in the current source scope.
verification.native: Compare Save and Create in Light/Dark/Increase Contrast, enabled/disabled/focused/saving, using the same build compatibility contract.

explicit_deviations: Save keeps defaultAction; Create deliberately has no defaultAction because Return in TextEditor must insert a newline.

source: Both named consumers use auroraToolbarAction with their existing symbols and action guards.
Both named labels use AuroraToolbarLabel with their existing title and primary SF Symbol.

verification.native: Same-source linked-13/15.4 comparison found that SDK compatibility removed calendar tint but not the separate tinted menu-arrow cell. Fresh native captures also rejected button menuStyle plus bordered because the indicator square remained. The subsequent hidden-framework-indicator/shared-SF-label correction still requires fresh native capture acceptance; source gates or metadata alone are not visual evidence.

explicit_deviations: User-authorized correction makes Event and Create-day share a native bordered button bezel; only the Menu changes from automatic menu presentation to button menuStyle.

The confirmed framework indicator render defect is addressed by hiding that indicator and showing the standard SF chevron in the shared label; no hand-drawn arrow, replacement bezel or local tint is introduced.
Menu keeps its existing menu-only click behavior and actions; it does not become a split button with a new primary action.

deferred_findings.owner: Native build parity and root verification work
deferred_findings.requirement: Compare the hidden framework indicator and shared SF-chevron label in actual output under the established build compatibility contract. The previous button-menu/bordered render was rejected. No guessed local tint, custom arrow drawing/bezel or source-only acceptance.
Inventory findings do not authorize rewriting timer, settings, empty-state or destructive-confirmation families.
